Develop a threat hunt plan and queries for MITRE ATT&CK technique T1567: Exfiltration Over Web Service (exfiltration).

{
  "technique_id": "T1567",
  "technique_name": "Exfiltration Over Web Service",
  "tactic": "exfiltration",
  "hunt_hypothesis": "Adversaries may utilize Exfiltration Over Web Service (T1567) to advance their operational objectives during exfiltration. We hypothesize that compromised hosts or rogue identities in our environment exhibit anomalous invocation patterns deviating from baseline system administrators.",
  "baseline_criteria": "Catalog authorized administrative scheduled tasks, known IT deployment service accounts, and approved software packages that legitimately interact with Exfiltration Over Web Service components.",
  "detection_queries": {
    "splunk_spl": "index=win_eventlog (EventCode=1 OR EventCode=4688) Process_Name=\"*exfiltration*\" | stats count by host, user, Process_Command_Line | where count < 5",
    "microsoft_sentinel_kql": "SecurityEvent | where EventID in (4688, 7045) | where CommandLine has_any (\"T1567\", \"exfiltration\") | summarize AggregatedCount=count() by Computer, Account, CommandLine",
    "elastic_eql": "process where event.category == \"process\" and event.type == \"start\" and process.name == \"*exfiltration*\""
  },
  "validation_and_next_steps": [
    "Correlate detected events against user logon timestamps (EventCode 4624)",
    "Inspect parent process execution tree for abnormal spawning origins",
    "Verify file hashes against VirusTotal or enterprise threat reputation repositories"
  ]
}
